Independent review of two parallel prongs. All changes uncommitted. Run `git diff HEAD` to see scope.

## Prong A — tex/L35_P3_obs_student.tex (aesthetics polish)
Eight aesthetic fixes applied to the 5/8 observation student packet:
1. Essential Understanding hyphenation: \mbox{Understanding} prevents mid-word break
2. Language Objective body: literal _ chars replaced with \framedline{} blanks
3. I-do table: switched tabularx X-cols to fixed p{1.7in}/p{4.8in}
4. tcolorbox internal borders: removed | colspec separators + \hline row rules
5. DOK-2 item 1 grid: wrapped in \begin{minipage}{\textwidth} to prevent orphan
6. Grid sizing: added 'sketch shape only' notes under both blank grids (keeps grid small)
7. End behavior '(Why? ___)' moved to its own line
8. (x²+9) bullet: 2 ruled lines -> 3

CHECK: rebuilt PDF page count = 4. Each fix actually landed visually. Mention any LaTeX log warnings beyond a single sub-pixel overfull. Confirm DOK-2 item 1 prompt + grid render together (page 3 OR page 4, not split).

## Prong B — L35_Pacer.html (and web/pacers/L35_Pacer.html mirror)
Re-baselined for new schedule. 3 tabs -> 4 tabs:
- P2 · Multiplicity (5/4–5/7)
- P3-OBS · Mystery Graph (Fri 5/8) ★ — NEW (observation lesson)
- P3-cont · Storage Box (5/11–5/13) — renamed from old P3
- P4 · Topic 3 Assessment (Thu 5/14)

Inline teacher content added for P3-OBS: Mystery Graph script + answer key, sentence frames, touch/cross rules.

CHECK: 
- Both files identical (`diff L35_Pacer.html web/pacers/L35_Pacer.html` should show nothing)
- Tabs render in expected order (read the HTML)
- Phase chip JS handlers and timer JS still work — look for broken references to old tab IDs (`p2`, `p3`, `p4`) vs new ones; if the ids changed, all chip onclick handlers and renderPanel iteration must match
- Dates in tab labels match the schedule (5/8 obs, 5/14 assess)
- No references to deprecated 'Tue/Wed/Thu' hard-coded labels remain

## Reporting format
For each prong: PASS / NIT / BLOCKER + at most 3 sentences. Global verdict + any cross-prong consistency issues. Total under 500 words.
